archimate:Principle.name: orchestration
archimate:Principle.documentation:
CONTEXT
The Integration Layer Pilot proves three patterns on Azure Integration Services and establishes repeatable standards for future delivery. For Orchestration, a consuming application calls a REST API through Azure API Management, and the integration layer retrieves and returns governed data from a source system.
Currently, consuming applications rely on direct database links to access MOP data, creating tight coupling between systems and bypassing enterprise data standards. Additionally, direct network connectivity to the on-premise MOP Oracle database is not viable within the pilot timeframe.
PROPOSAL
Deliver a new read-only MOP REST API hosted on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) as the standard way to retrieve MOP data, replacing direct database links. The consuming application submits a request through Azure API Management, the MOP API queries the database to fetch the required records and maps them into the agreed canonical data model. It then attaches mandatory metadata headers and returns the response using the standard enterprise error format.
The MOP API operates strictly in read-only mode against a static, point-in-time snapshot of the MOP Oracle database. Because this copy is a fixed snapshot in time with no ongoing data refresh, it is used solely to validate the API orchestration pattern during the pilot.

properties.value: Synchronous Orchestration via Managed MOP API and Temporary Azure Database Snapshot
